gen-fs-expose-gf-maven-pro: Expose packs its capitals and lowercase into a tight, squeezed line with barely a pause between them. And Maven Pro goes the other way, drawing every stroke with one steady nib and leaving its c gently open.
gen-fs-expose-gf-michroma: Expose sits tight and compressed, almost breathless up top. Michroma counters with wide spacing around every letter and curves that leave daylight, a spread-out, tall-bodied sans-serif that gives the pair its clearest quality: tension against room.
gen-fs-expose-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws its letters with the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen, and its lowercase stands tall, with an s that opens generously. But Expose above it is the tighter voice, squeezing its heights close with hardly a pause between letters.
gen-fs-expose-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Expose crowds its lowercase up near the capitals, with a squeezed, striking cadence that barely stops for breath. And Mochiy Pop P One answers with wide gaps between letters and a bent-pipe-cleaner texture, a plain sans with no brush swell.
gen-fs-expose-gf-montserrat-alternates: Montserrat Alternates has tubular, wire-like letterforms, with a c as open as a bent paperclip and lowercase crowding the capital line. Its strongest quality is the tension against Expose.
gen-fs-expose-gf-montserrat-underline: Expose is the striking one, with its compressed, nearly pauseless rhythm and lowercase pressed up against the capitals. Montserrat Underline is the steady one, drawing every curve with a single constant line width and oversized lowercase.
gen-fs-expose-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, a plain sans that feels friendly. And Expose above it stays compressed and refined, so the text beneath feels generous in comparison.
gen-fs-expose-gf-mozilla-text: Tall, bold-looking lowercase with flared terminals. Expose does its best work compressed and striking, with barely a pause between letters, while Mozilla Text does its best as a sans with substantial, tall bodies.
gen-fs-expose-gf-nata-sans: Technical-pen steadiness under a squeezed headline. The pair's strongest quality is the gap between Expose, tight and pauseless, and Nata Sans, with its large central band and wide, unclosed curves.
gen-fs-expose-gf-nobile: Tight, striking, then suddenly open. Expose keeps its heights close and its cadence compressed, and Nobile follows with a plain sans whose letter mouths stay open like an unjoined chalk arc.
